pageContext.keyMessage: Transform your business without the overwhelm

variants.name: Trust-First Authority
variants.approach: Lead with credibility and social proof to overcome skepticism. Ideal for markets where trust is the primary barrier to conversion.
variants.mood: Professional, clean, lots of white space
variants.bestFor: B2B, professional services, enterprise sales, industries with trust issues
variants.tradeoffs: May feel less energetic; slower path to CTA
uxPrinciples: Social Proof: Others' actions validate the choice

variants.name: Bold Transformation
variants.approach: Create emotional impact with bold visuals and transformation-focused messaging. For clients who want to stand out.
variants.bestFor: Creative agencies, disruptors, brands targeting younger audiences
variants.tradeoffs: May alienate conservative audiences; less content density
uxPrinciples: Von Restorff Effect: Distinctive design is memorable

variants.name: Methodical Educator
variants.approach: Provide comprehensive information for analytical buyers who research thoroughly before deciding.
variants.conversionStyle: Progressive - multiple soft CTAs, one strong final CTA
variants.bestFor: Technical products, considered purchases, B2B with long sales cycles
variants.tradeoffs: Longer page; may lose impulsive buyers; more content to maintain

recommendation.reason: Based on the target audience of small business owners, trust and credibility are primary concerns. The Trust-First approach addresses skepticism before asking for commitment, which aligns with the typical decision-making process for consulting services.
